title: How would you estimate how many parcels are delivered to UK homes each year?
description: A step-by-step estimate for "How many parcels are delivered to UK homes each year?" with the approach, the maths and a sanity check.
hook: Households are a better starting point than people here, because parcels are delivered to homes. Have a go at your own estimate before reading on.
body:
The question

How many parcels are delivered to UK homes each year?

The approach

Households × parcels per week × weeks.

Tip: Name the assumption that matters most, so the interviewer knows where the estimate is most sensitive.

Step by step

  1. UK households: 28M
  2. × 2 parcels per household per week
  3. × 52 weeks

That gives about 2.91B parcels a year.

Does it make sense?

Deliveries to businesses come on top, so total parcel volumes will be noticeably higher than this.

Real-world check

UK households numbered about 28.6 million in 2024 (ONS), so the 28 million used here is a sensible round number.

Source: ONS: Families and households in the UK, 2024.
